capabilities: Start and stop a timer from the macOS menu bar with a live elapsed-time readout
Write each session as a markdown note with project, start, end, duration, and date frontmatter
Group sessions by project and sum durations in a shipped Base
Resume a running timer after an Obsidian restart
Cancel a running timer or open settings from the tray right-click menu
extras: Live menu-bar readout is macOS-only (Tray.setTitle); the timer and note-writing still work elsewhere. Install instructions are for a local/development copy (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into the vault), and the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a manual verification checklist because there is no headless Obsidian test harness.
motivation: Built to keep the data yours: the author wanted time logs as plain markdown in the vault, not a SaaS database.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in time tracking, and external trackers keep session data in outside services instead of plain markdown in the vault.

relations.evidence: Coexists with Headless Mode: both menu-bar icons work; neither destroys the other.

summary: Menu-bar timer for macOS that starts and stops project timers, writes each session as a markdown note, and rolls up time per project in a Base.
